Name: Discount
Expression: SUM ( Parts_Promo[SALE_VAL] )

Name: Cost Value
Expression: SUM ( Parts_Promo[Part_Cost] )

Name: Original Sale Value
Expression: SUM ( Parts_Promo[Part_Sales] )

Name: Original Margin $
Expression: [Original Sale Value] - [Cost Value]

Name: Original Margin %
Expression: DIVIDE ( [Original Margin $], [Original Sale Value] )

Name: Net Sales Value
Expression: [Original Sale Value] + [Discount]

Name: Net Margin $
Expression: [Net Sales Value] - [Cost Value]

Name: Net Margin %
Expression: DIVIDE ( [Net Margin $], [Net Sales Value] )

Name: Discount %
Expression: DIVIDE ( ABS ( [Discount] ), [Original Sale Value] )

Name: Rolling12MonthCount
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( 'Parts_Promo' ),
    FILTER (
        'Parts_Promo',
        'Parts_Promo'[Rolling12MonthFlag] = 1
            && 'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] = MAX ( 'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] )
    )
)

Name: PreviousYearRollingCount
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( 'Parts_Promo' ),
    FILTER (
        'Parts_Promo',
        'Parts_Promo'[PreviousYearRollingFlag] = 1
            && 'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] = MAX ( 'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] )
    )
)

Name: PercentChangeRolling
Expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Rolling12MonthCount] - [PreviousYearRollingCount],
    [PreviousYearRollingCount],
    0
)

Name: Rolling12MonthNetSalesValue
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUMX (
        FILTER (
            'Parts_Promo',
            'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] >= EDATE ( TODAY (), -12 )
                && 'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] <= TODAY ()
        ),
        [Net Sales Value]
    ),
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'Parts_Promo' ),
        'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] = MAX ( 'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] )
    )
)

Name: PreviousYearRollingNetSalesValue
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUMX (
        FILTER (
            'Parts_Promo',
            'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] >= EDATE ( TODAY (), -24 )
                && 'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] <= EDATE ( TODAY (), -12 )
        ),
        [Net Sales Value]
    ),
    FILTER (
        ALL ( 'Parts_Promo' ),
        'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] = MAX ( 'Parts_Promo'[PART_NO] )
    )
)

Name: PercentChangeNetSalesValue
Expression:
DIVIDE (
    [Rolling12MonthNetSalesValue] - [PreviousYearRollingNetSalesValue],
    [PreviousYearRollingNetSalesValue],
    0
)

Expression: SUM ( InTrans_All_Promo[SALE_VAL] )

Name: NetSalesValueByPartNo
Expression:
CALCULATE (
    SUM ( Parts_Promo[Net Sales Value] ),
    FILTER (
        Parts_Promo,
        Parts_Promo[PART_NO] IN VALUES ( InTrans_All_Promo[PART_NO] )
    )
)

Name: PercentToSaleVal
Expression: DIVIDE ( [NetSalesValueByPartNo], [Total SALE_VAL], 0 )

Name: Greeting
Expression:
VAR CurrentHour = HOUR(NOW())
VAR AdjustedHour = MOD(CurrentHour - 6, 24)
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE(),
        AdjustedHour < 12, "Good morning, ",
        AdjustedHour < 18, "Good afternoon, ",
        "Good evening, "
    )

Name: User

RETURN
    RIGHT ( USERNAME (), LEN ( _user ) - SEARCH ( "\", _user ) )

RETURN

Name: SelectedMaxRow
Expression: MAXX(FILTER('Pagnation Table', 'Pagnation Table'[Page Number] = SELECTEDVALUE('Pagnation Table'[Page Number])),'Pagnation Table'[Max Row])

Name: SelectedMinRow
Expression: MINX(FILTER('Pagnation Table', 'Pagnation Table'[Page Number] = SELECTEDVALUE('Pagnation Table'[Page Number])), 'Pagnation Table'[Min Row])

Name: _ShowValueForDates
Expression:
VAR __LastDateWithData =
    CALCULATE (
        MAXX ( { MAX ( 'Parts_Promo'[Trans_Datetime] ), MAX ( 'Data Refresh'[CurrentDateTime] ), MAX ( 'Data Refresh'[Date] ) }, ''[Value] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS ()
    )
VAR __FirstDateVisible =
    MIN ( 'Date'[Date] )
VAR __Result =
    __FirstDateVisible <= __LastDateWithData
RETURN
    __Result
